description.zh: 像素风横版跳跃游戏。踩扁小怪、顶出金币、躲开陷阱，一路跑到旗杆终点。支持键盘与触屏操作，自动保存最高分。
description.en: A pixel-art side-scrolling platformer. Stomp enemies, bump blocks, dodge pits and race to the flagpole. Keyboard & touch controls, best score auto-saved.

controls.zh: ←→/AD 移动，空格/↑/W 跳跃，Esc/P 暂停；触屏设备提供屏幕按钮
controls.en: Arrows/A-D to move, Space/Up/W to jump, Esc/P to pause; on-screen buttons on touch devices
